'''Politics and elections'''
* [[2026 Delhi Jantar Mantar protests]]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Esports World Cup]]
**[[League of Legends in esports|''League of Legends'' in esports]]
***In [[esports]], [[Dplus KIA]] defeats [[Karmine Corp]] 3–0 to win the ''[[League of Legends]]'' title at the 2026 [[Esports World Cup]], extending [[South Korea]]'s winning streak to three years and securing its first international title since 2020. [https://www.dazn.com/en-GB/news/e-sports/leagueoflegends-ewc-26-winners-dplus-kia-karmine-corp-results-t3r/yvojb1azbx1y1hbc95uiq3kk1 (DAZN)]
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[2026 FIFA World Cup final]]
***In [[association football]], [[Spain national football team|Spain]] win their second [[FIFA World Cup]] title after defeating the [[2022 FIFA World Cup final|defending champions]] [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]] 1–0 after [[extra time]] in the final held at [[MetLife Stadium]] in [[East Rutherford, New Jersey|East Rutherford]], [[New Jersey]], United States. Spain's captain [[Rodri (footballer, born 1996)|Rodri]] is awarded the [[Golden Ball (FIFA World Cup)|Golden Ball]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/sport/20260719-world-cup-2026-spain-crowned-champions-after-extra-time-thriller-against-argentina (France 24)] [https://sports.yahoo.com/soccer/live/spain-argentina-world-cup-2026-score-result-schedule-live-updates-130000682.html?guccounter=1 (Yahoo! Sports)]
**[[Spain at the FIFA World Cup]]
***After winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup, Spain becomes [[FIFA World Cup records and statistics|the first country]] to hold both the men's and [[FIFA Women's World Cup|women's World Cups]], having won the latter in [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup|2023]]. The men's team extends their [[List of world association football records|international football record]] of 38 consecutive unbeaten matches, surpassing [[Italy national football team|Italy]]'s record of 37. It also becomes the first team to field two teenagers, [[Lamine Yamal]] and [[Pau Cubarsí]], both 19-year-olds, in a FIFA World Cup final. [https://www.npr.org/2026/07/17/g-s1-134232/spain-world-cup-history-women-men (NPR)] [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/spain-coach-de-la-fuente-hails-world-class-players-2026-07-19/ (Reuters)] [https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/every-teenager-start-world-cup-final-and-win (FOX Sports)]
***Spanish manager [[Luis de la Fuente (footballer, born 1961)|Luis de la Fuente]] also becomes the oldest manager to win a World Cup title at 65 years old. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/spain-coach-de-la-fuente-hails-world-class-players-2026-07-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[AI boom]]
**Mathematician and [[Anthropic]] employee [[Levent Alpöge]] presents an explicit counterexample to the [[Jacobian conjecture]] in three-dimensional space that disproves the <math>n</math>-variable conjecture for <math>n > 2</math> using the [[large language model]] [[Fable 5]]. The Jacobian conjecture for <math>n = 1</math> remains true. [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/tech/tech-news/ai-helps-harvard-mathematician-crack-near-century-old-math-problem-5101182.html (VNexpress)] [https://www.newscientist.com/article/2580374-ais-solution-to-87-year-old-riddle-takes-mathematicians-by-surprise/ (NewScientist)]
